prompt: Express the coulomb ($\text{C}$), the derived unit of electric charge, in terms of SI base units.

mark_scheme.criterion: A s (or s A, ampere second).

hints: Recall the formula relating charge Q to current I and time t: Q = It.
Substitute the SI base units of current and time.
solution: Electric charge is defined by Q = It. Current is measured in amperes (A) and time in seconds (s). Therefore, 1 C = 1 A s.
teacher_walkthrough: Key anchor for electricity base-unit conversions.
Students must know Q = It -> C = A s.

provenance.independence_statement: Authored as an original drill deriving the base units of the coulomb.
